title: The Cooperative's Charge for Settling an Estate on a Membership and Patronage Equity Account
content:
The cooperative's charge for settling an estate on a Membership and Patronage Equity account follows the work the file has taken.

**Where the file has been carried.** Where the estate's application has stood registered for more than 90 days and the class issues a written certificate for retained equity, the charge is 60.00.

**Where the file is recent.** Where the estate's application has stood registered for 90 days or fewer and the class issues a written certificate for retained equity, the charge is 25.00.

**Where the class issues no certificate.** No charge is made for settling the estate.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical records

| Days the estate's application has stood registered | Class issues a written certificate for retained equity | Charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 140 | yes | 60.00 |
| 91 | yes | 60.00 |
| 90 | yes | 25.00 |
| 12 | yes | 25.00 |
| 140 | no | none |

The boundary is at 90 days: an application standing exactly 90 days has not stood more than 90, so the charge is 25.00. The days are counted from the date the latest estate retirement application registered on the Membership and Patronage Equity account was requested. Whether the class issues a written certificate for retained equity at all is what the class schedule records against it, and where it issues none the age of the file does not come into the charge.
